d:
Purniya ke sansad Pappu Yadav ka rojgar abhiyan lagatar jari hai. pichhle chhah mahinon men tisri bar rojgar karyakram ke jarie yuvaon ko naukri ka avsar diya gaya aur chaynit abhyarthiyon ko ophar letar bante gae. isse pahle agast men purniya men aayojit rojgar mele men 50 se adhik kanpniyon ne hissa liya tha aur 6 hajar se adhik yuvaon ke chayan ki jankari samne aaee thi.
Pappu Yadav ne har chhah mahine men rojgar mela aayojit karne aur yuvaon ko rojgar se jorne ka sankalp jataya tha. ab unke is rojgar abhiyan ko lekar ek bar phir charcha ho rahi hai.
